answer.reason: The verses state several deeds of Michael: helping against the prince of Persia, disputing with the devil, and fighting the dragon.

clauses.english: came to help against the prince of Persia
clauses.quote: Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me

clauses.english: disputed with the devil about the body of Moses
clauses.quote: contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses

clauses.english: fought with his angels against the dragon in heaven
clauses.quote: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon

doubts: DAN 12:1 foretells that Michael will stand up in the future, so it was left out as not a past event.
DAN 10:21 only says he holds with the speaker, so it was not used.
